name: Phoenix's Melody
overview: When Gu Chengfeng, a business heir from Licheng, Quanzhou, visits a She ethnic village, he meets Lan Ninger, a girl posing as a tour guide and known as the village’s “Phoenix Maiden.” As they set off to uncover the truth behind the legend, misunderstandings turn into teamwork, and their journey becomes one of cultural rediscovery, community revival, and unexpected romance.
